narrative:
## Handover Summary — ALM & Interest Rate Risk

## Key Decisions
• Extend reinvestment duration on maturing bonds to 3.8 years (+EUR 0.75M NII a year)
• Align Spanish term deposit pricing with the peer median (+EUR 0.36M)
• Raise the fixed-rate share of new mortgages to 35%

signals.title: Net interest income down 6.6% as rates fall
signals.excerpt: Interest income fell from €102.3M to €95.9M; NII from €86.5M to €80.8M while loans grew 13.5% to €1.72Bn.
